Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. description: Standard Job Description The Data and AI Enablement organization is seeking an Enterprise Ontology Product Owner to serve as the connective role between the business functions that own enterprise ontologies and the technical teams that build them. This person ensures that ontology models are grounded in real business meaning, validated by the people who use them, and adopted across AI-enabled experiences, analytics tools, and data products. This is not a technical modeling role. There are dedicated technical teams responsible for building and maintaining ontologies. Instead, this role requires someone who can operate fluently across business functions, translate business language and logic into requirements the technical team can act on, and hold the line on quality, consistency, and adoption. Success depends on deep functional domain expertise, strong facilitation skills, and enough technical fluency to be a credible partner to data engineering and AI/ML teams, not on the ability to build ontologies directly. What You’ll Do Validate and prioritize ontology use cases – ensure models align with business goals, governance policies, and real‑world terminology while coaching business functions to develop competency questions that test scope and correctness. Translate business intent into clear, engineer‑ready requirements and bring stakeholders in as co‑creators through workshops, so data‑engineering and AI/ML teams can build efficiently and without duplication. Collaborate with data product owners and platform teams to guarantee that ontology‑driven data products integrate smoothly with the broader data‑product ecosystem, avoiding conflicts or redundant effort. Drive delivery and quality assurance – track progress, remove blockers, enforce production‑grade data‑pipeline controls, and evaluate the quality and business value of engineered outputs before stakeholder hand‑off. Communicate value and promote adoption – explain modeling decisions in plain language, showcase possibilities with generative‑AI tools, and champion the product to senior leadership and end users. Maintain a continuous feedback loop – gather ongoing stakeholder input, iterate on ontology scope, and update success metrics (adoption, usage, consistency, AI answer quality, business impact) to demonstrate measurable value. Lead cross‑functional delivery teams and partner with business function owners to clarify RACI responsibilities while owning the overall process, coordination, and quality of the ontology. Basic Qualifications Experience working with or on ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models in a professional capacity. Proven ability to partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into structured documentation or models. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of explaining technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. What Success Looks Like You’ll know you are successful when business functions trust the ontology as an accurate reflection of how they define their own data and processes, technical teams receive clear, validated requirements to build against, and adoption of ontology‑driven capabilities grows measurably across AI‑enabled experiences, analytics tools, and data products. Success is demonstrated by high usage metrics, concrete business impact, and a continuous cycle of stakeholder‑driven evolution of the product. Must be a U.S. citizen. Basic Qualifications • Experience working with or on ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models in some professional capacity • Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into structured documentation or models • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to explain technical or structured concepts to non-technical audiences Desired Skills Deep functional domain expertise in one or more enterprise areas (e.g., finance, supply chain, sales, HR, product). Background in product ownership, business analysis, or a coordination‑heavy role focused on validation of use cases. Experience with enterprise data products, platforms, and pipelines (Databricks, data warehouses, MDM, etc.). Experience with data governance, metadata management, or master‑data programs. Familiarity with AI‑enabled experiences, analytics tools, and the broader data‑product ecosystem. Ability to facilitate workshops and engage stakeholders as co‑creators. Understanding of how ontologies improve AI answer quality, semantic search/discovery, and overall business value. Experience with large‑scale enterprise systems (SAP, ERP, etc.) to anchor business terminology in operational data. description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit . The Team: The Knowledge Graph Platform team builds the foundational systems that help Reddit understand entities, relationships, and context across its content. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge. This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. This team is strategically positioned to impact both ads and consumer roadmaps. Our data is used across ads marketplace models as well as user-facing features on . What You’ll Do: Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers building Reddit’s Knowledge Graph Platform; create a high-trust, high-performing environment with clear goals and strong technical ownership. Set the technical direction and roadmap for a scalable knowledge graph platform, including data and API contracts, service interfaces, reliability, observability, performance, and developer experience. Establish production-grade operating standards: defining SLOs, implementing quality measures of data within the knowledge graph, governance mechanisms, and safe change-management practices. Partner with engineering, computational linguists, and domain-expert teams to define a shared operating model for ontology, data quality, governance, and platform evolution. Be a steward of data in the KG - ensure the graph has the coverage and freshness needed for priority use cases. Work with our dedicated data labeler team on shared goals around data coverage and quality. Work closely with internal product and engineering teams to understand their needs, prioritize high-value use cases, and increase access to the platform. Drive the next wave of graph-powered capabilities, including opportunities in shopping, search, ads marketplace models, consumer feed models. Stay close to architecture and technical design, helping the team navigate complex system tradeoffs and contribute hands-on when it is the highest-leverage path. Communicate the team’s strategy, priorities, risks, and progress clearly across a distributed, cross-functional organization. Who You Might Be: 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with 2+ years directly managing, coaching, and developing engineering teams. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience building or operating AI/ML powered, or data-intensive platforms, with a proven track record of leading shared technical systems with multiple internal customers. Strong understanding of how to turn a technical system into a product-like platform: setting an operating model with customers, establishing data or service-level contracts, useful documentation, and a path to self-service adoption. Experience establishing data contracts around quality, lineage, or governance. Strong technical judgment across distributed systems, backend services, data platforms, APIs, reliability, and operational excellence. Comfortable making technical and product tradeoffs in ambiguity, including when a dedicated product manager is not present. Excellent collaborator and communicator who can earn trust with engineers, senior leaders, and partner teams across time zones. Enjoy building clarity and durable operating mechanisms where ownership and processes are still evolving. Excel in evangelization and driving platform adoption cross org. Nice to Have: Master’s or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, or a related field. Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic or ontology systems, entity resolution, search, or contextual grounding is highly desired. description: About us We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem. We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us? Your new role - The Sales Director within the Digital Science Enterprise Segment drives top-line revenue growth by owning the full commercial sales cycle across our integrated portfolio, including Dimensions, Altmetric, ReadCube, Figshare, and metaphacts. This role is responsible for driving pipeline generation, rigorous deal qualification, framing client-centric value propositions, aligning portfolio solutions with enterprise strategic objectives, and leading pricing and contracting negotiations. High priority is placed on a solid conceptual and domain understanding of Knowledge Graph architecture, semantic ontologies, the Semantic Layer, and Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate brings a proven sales track record in Life Sciences and excels at bridging high-level enterprise data integration discussions with executive procurement and budget cycles. Technical skills are desired but not required. What you’ll be doing Pipeline Generation & Prospecting Proactively identify, target, and initiate strategic conversations with C-suite leaders, R&D executives, and data architects across Life Sciences, BioPharma, and research-intensive enterprises. Execute territory plans to build a high-volume, high-quality sales pipeline across the full Digital Science capability set. Position Digital Science's unique portfolio advantage—leveraging connections between grants, patents, publications, clinical trials, and knowledge graphs. Deal Qualification & Opportunity Management Apply structured qualification frameworks to evaluate enterprise leads and focus resources on high-probability opportunities. Manage and prioritize enterprise opportunities based on deal value. Map complex decision-making structures to identify executive sponsors, budget holders, and technical evaluators. Seek up-sell and cross-sell opportunities by partnering with Account Managers and Customer Engagement Managers. Coordinated pitches and responses to request for proposals (RFPs). Value Proposition Development & Value Alignment Articulate a compelling, value-based sales narrative focused on the "why" rather than just the "how". Translate complex conceptual capabilities—such as Semantic Web standards, open research workflows, and patent analytics—into clear ROI, de-risked R&D, and accelerated discovery for C-suite leaders. Align Digital Science enterprise solutions with the client’s internal digital transformation, AI readiness, and knowledge management strategies. Pricing & Contracting Negotiations Navigate enterprise procurement, legal, and security review cycles effectively to optimize deal velocity. Lead commercial negotiations, proposal creation, price positioning, and contract execution. Structure multi-product enterprise agreements that maximize deal value, protect margins, and establish long-term customer retention. Portfolio Cross-Selling & Internal Collaboration Act as the commercial lead across products (Dimensions, Altmetric, ReadCube, Figshare, and metaphacts.) Leverage internal resources, including Pre-Sales Specialists (Solutions Architects), Product thought leaders and Marketing resources. Partner closely with colleagues during pre-sales discovery, proof-of-concept (PoC) designs, and technical validations. Work alongside Account Managers to ensure smooth post-sale transitions and identify account expansion opportunities. What you’ll bring to the role Core Commercial Requirements Track Record: 5+ years of demonstrated success in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, solution consulting, or strategic account management with a proven record of hitting quota targets. Negotiation Skills: Proven experience navigating multi-stakeholder procurement and structuring high-value enterprise software contracts. Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and data concepts to executive audiences. Domain Expertise (Preferred) Enterprise Information Architecture: Demonstrated commercial or domain familiarity with Enterprise Information Architecture (EIA) frameworks and semantic modeling is highly desired, enabling you to articulate how unifying siloed enterprise data assets into a semantic layer powers context-rich decision intelligence and Agentic AI workflows. Knowledge Graphs & Ontologies: High priority on solid domain understanding of knowledge graphs, semantic ontologies, linked data, and the role of the Semantic Layer in enterprise AI and R&D. Life Sciences Focus: Strong preference for experience selling software, scientific data, or intelligence platforms into Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Biotech accounts. Industry Standards: Familiarity with Resource Description Framework (RDF) concepts and Open Access (OA) publishing models. Technical Background (Desirable) Technical proficiency or hands-on data skills (e.g., SPARQL, Python, graph databases) are a bonus/desired, but not required. The primary focus is commercial execution paired with domain fluency. Travel Willingness and ability to travel 20%–40% for customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry conferences. We're looking for people who are naturally curious about AI and comfortable exploring how it can improve the way we work — you don't need to be an AI expert, but an openness to experiment and adapt is important to us. Don't worry if you don't meet every qualification—let us be the judge! Studies show that many qualified candidates from under-represented groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team and strongly encourage you to submit your application. Living our Values We invest in, nurture and support innovative businesses and technologies that make all parts of the research process more open, efficient and effective. The talent we secure is fundamental to us achieving our vision and our growth plans. The values we live by are: We are brave in the pursuit of better We are collaborative and inclusive We are always open-minded We are from and for the community At Digital Science, our vision is to see research flow seamlessly – trusted, collaborative, and accessible – fueling breakthroughs that push humanity forward. This ambitious mission is one we achieve together, by enabling open, collaborative, inclusive research. We firmly believe that to truly innovate and solve the complex challenges faced by our customers, from researchers and universities to funders and publishers, we need diverse perspectives, experiences, and ideas. A rich mix of voices drives quality insights, fosters enhanced collaboration, and ultimately pushes knowledge forward more effectively. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building and nurturing a workplace where every individual feels valued and belongs. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Beyond recruitment, we strive to cultivate an environment where inclusivity is woven into the fabric of our culture, enabling everyone to be their best self and do their best work. description: Clinical Analytics Specialist – MD Are you a licensed MD looking to help drive innovation within our global organization? About the role. We are looking for an MD to serve as our Clinical Analytics Specialist to join the Data Discovery and Enrichment Team (DDE). The Clinical Analytics Specialist will provide support for clinical decision support (CDS) product development to improve the search and discovery experience for users of products such as ClinicalKey at the point-of-care. You will have a critical role in working with the Clinical Solutions and Education business units to provide clinical analytics support and drive growth, revenue generation, and innovation. About the team. This team is entrusted with the validation of extracted medical information from Elsevier corpus and electronic health care records, information retrieval, creating data for gold set generation, and participating in content enrichment workflows aiding in clinical decision support. Experience Clinical degree required (MD, MBBS,GP) Preference given to those with formal training or significant experience in evidence-based medicine, clinical research, epidemiology, biostatistics, and the application of evidence to practice. Experience in semantic technologies, including text mining, ontology management is a plus. Excellent command of the English language in both spoken and written forms is required and some level of proficiency with another language is a plus. Experience with medical vocabularies such as SNOMED CT and ICD-10 is beneficial, as is knowledge of ontology modeling. Extensive computer skill competency. Proficiency in a Microsoft Windows environment; and strong MS Word/Powerpoint skills and ability to work with templates using an electronic content management system. Visualization and dashboarding skills (e.g. using Tableau) is a plus. Demonstrated problem-solving ability, sense of urgency, and ability to prioritize tasks, to work simultaneously on multiple projects, and to ensure completion of editorial team projects per tight timelines. The Clinical Analytics Specialist should be a clinician (MD, MBBS or GP) with experience in informatics and knowledge retrieval Able to work with a variety of stakeholders at the mid and senior management level Responsibilities Appling clinical knowledge to extract and integrate data in a healthcare environment. Adapting domain ontologies for information extraction, data modeling and analysis. Working closely with data scientists, clinicians, subject matter experts (SMEs), taxonomists, and data analysts to provide insights used in automation and applications for our businesses in health markets Working on the modeling, validation, and maintenance of core extracted clinical relationships to deliver an evidence-based and development of Elsevier’s healthcare knowledge graph (H-graph). Providing insight for ensuring high quality of automated indexing for search & discovery. Appling own domain knowledge and work with external clinical experts to confirm and validate clinical accuracy of content. Ensure that content is clinically accurate, current, and supported by the best available evidence from the medical literature, current guidelines, and accepted performance standards. Building domain specific training data sets for machine learning (ML) models used in Point-of-care products Predictive analytics and insights from combining big datasets in healthcare Participating in design, prototyping, and analytics in their day to day providing insights for algorithm codification that will improve clinical workflows and content creation. Elsevier is a renowned global information analytics company that primarily focuses on providing scientific, technical, and medical (STM) research content, tools, and services. It is one of the largest publishers of academic journals and scholarly literature in the world. Elsevier operates in various domains, including science, technology, medicine, social sciences, and more. They publish a vast number of peer-reviewed journals covering a wide range of disciplines. These journals act as platforms for researchers and academics to share their findings and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields. In addition to publishing, Elsevier offers a suite of digital solutions and services to support researchers, scientists, and professionals in their work. description: About airSlate airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines. At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment. We are looking for a hands-on leader to run Data Enablement. The team that owns how our data is modeled, trusted, and made ready for the business and for AI. You will lead analytics engineers and web analytics specialists, own the semantic layer end-to-end, and turn raw product and event data into curated, well-documented datasets that people can rely on. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Lead and grow the team. Set priorities, coach, and keep a steady delivery rhythm across analytics engineering and web analytics. Own the semantic layer. Design, build and evolve SQL-based models and metric definitions so that one number means one thing across all our products. Raise data curation and automate the routine. Move the team from ad hoc requests to reusable, tested, documented datasets that people and our AI data assistant can query directly, with tracking checks and data-quality monitoring on autopilot. Set standards and partner across the data organization. Modeling conventions, version control, testing and release practices, code review; work with Data Business Partners, Data Science / ML and Data Platform on scope and ownership. Stay close to the code on critical builds. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: Experience. 5+ years in analytics, data or BI engineering, including 2+ years leading a team or leading others technically. Expert SQL and Python. You set query and performance standards others follow, rewrite expensive queries and explain the trade-offs, handle incremental loads, deduplication and slowly changing dimensions, and own production Python components that other teams depend on. Data modeling and pipelines. You design warehouse and mart models that several teams build on, including a semantic layer, and choose the methodology (star schema, Data Vault or equivalent) to fit the queries it must serve. You optimize and troubleshoot pipelines on a cloud stack such as AWS (Athena, Redshift, Glue) and orchestration tools such as Airflow. Engineering discipline. You set branching and code review standards, require schema and data tests and CI before release, and lead risky changes with a clear rollout and rollback plan. Data quality and data fluency. You design validation that catches problems before stakeholders do, fix root causes rather than symptoms, set documentation standards, and investigate unfamiliar sources before trusting them. Business impact. You design solution options for complex problems, split cross-team work into pieces with a clear definition of done, build dashboards around the decision they support, and become a trusted partner to business leaders. AI in everyday work. You redesign team workflows around AI tools to drive adoption, and evaluate AI outputs for quality, privacy and bias. Leadership and ownership. You own complex team-level projects, make high-impact decisions from complex information, coach people by spotting skill gaps and giving regular feedback, set clear scope expectations, and turn change into actionable steps for the team. Communication. You clarify complex ideas, build consensus across teams and time zones, and communicate in fluent English. Nice to have: experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework (we may adopt one); web analytics and tracking (GTM, GA4); B2B SaaS or document-workflow / e-signature background. What we offer Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries. Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth. Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate. Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge. Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance. Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams. Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow. description: Dir & Data Engineer - GE06BE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The Principal Ontologist and Graph Modeler is responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing enterprise semantic models, ontologies, and knowledge representations that provide meaning, context, and explainability for AI-driven analytics, agentic systems, and decision automation across the Business Insurance data portfolio. This role ensures that Business Insurance concepts, entities, relationships, metrics, rules, and behaviors are explicitly modeled and consistently applied across data products and AI systems. The role enables reuse, trust, reasoning, semantic interoperability, and scalable AI adoption across underwriting, policy, claims, distribution, customer, product, and portfolio domains. Operating at the intersection of business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, this role translates complex insurance domain knowledge into production-ready semantic assets that are consumable by both humans and machines. Job Responsibilities: Lead the design and execution of enterprise-scale semantic layers for the Business Insurance data portfolio to standardize business meaning and enable trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases. Define and operationalize ontologies, context graphs, and knowledge graphs across Business Insurance domains to power reasoning, explainability, and decision intelligence. Model core insurance concepts and relationships spanning customers, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance. Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics by ensuring large language models and agents can consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships. Define canonical semantic vocabularies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured Business Insurance data sources. Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, governance, security, and lifecycle management. Define and promote standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, and ontology reuse across delivery teams. Partner with Business Insurance data product owners, domain leaders, architects, and engineers to embed semantic models into data products, AI pipelines, analytics, and activation layers. Work closely with AI Data Architects and AI Data Engineers to operationalize ontologies through graphs, metadata services, APIs, and production data platforms. Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards. Enable explainability by ensuring AI and analytical outputs can be traced to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data. Serve as the principal authority for semantic engineering, ontology, and graph-modeling practices supporting the Business Insurance data portfolio. Advance agentic data engineering through reference patterns, playbooks, proofs of value, and production deployments. Contribute to communities of practice, reference guidance, reusable assets, and internal enablement materials. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience with large scale data warehouses data. 8–12+ years of hands-on experience in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale. Deep, hands-on expertise with RDF, OWL (OWL 2), RDFS, SKOS, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards. Proven experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs and governed semantic assets. Hands-on experience with graph or triple-store technologies such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Spanner Graph. Experience integrating knowledge graphs with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks. Strong understanding of AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability. Experience integrating semantic layers with data platforms, APIs, metadata systems, analytics platforms, and AI pipelines. Ability to translate complex insurance domain knowledge into formal, machine-readable semantic and graph structures. Strong understanding of context-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, and semantic interoperability. Proven ability to move from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise capability. Strong executive influence and thought leadership in semantic engineering, agentic analytics, and AI-native data engineering. Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, and Snowflake. Business Insurance domain knowledge across one or more areas such as underwriting, policy, claims, distribution, product, customer, or portfolio management. Excellent communication, presentation, collaboration, and technical leadership skills. Candidate must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. Nuestra cultura combina excelencia técnica, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo y una fuerte orientación a las personas. La Inteligencia Artificial forma parte de nuestra manera de trabajar, innovar y resolver problemas. Buscamos incorporar nuevas tecnologías para construir mejores productos y potenciar las capacidades de nuestros equipos. Si te apasiona la tecnología, disfrutás resolver desafíos complejos y querés participar en proyectos donde tu trabajo tenga impacto, nos encantaría conocerte. Sobre el rol Estamos buscando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con experiencia práctica en Neo4j, Cypher y modelado de datos en grafos para sumarse a un proyecto innovador de LegalTech enfocado en transformar la manera en que se organiza, conecta y consulta información legal, tributaria, contable y regulatoria. Vas a participar en el desarrollo y evolución de un Knowledge Graph que permitirá relacionar grandes volúmenes de información, identificar conexiones semánticas y potenciar soluciones de búsqueda inteligente basadas en Inteligencia Artificial. Esta posición combina Data Engineering, Graph Databases e Inteligencia Artificial, con un fuerte enfoque en la construcción de soluciones productivas, escalables y mantenibles. Trabajarás junto a equipos de Data Science, Backend e IA para transformar modelos conceptuales, taxonomías y ontologías en estructuras de grafos eficientes que alimenten arquitecturas de recuperación de información como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Buscamos una persona con una base sólida en ingeniería de datos, experiencia real trabajando con Neo4j y motivación por seguir desarrollándose en Knowledge Graphs, búsqueda semántica y GraphRAG. ¿Qué vas a hacer? Modelado de grafos: Diseñar, implementar y mantener modelos de datos en Neo4j, representando entidades, relaciones, jerarquías y estructuras complejas de información. Ingeniería de datos: Construir y optimizar pipelines ETL/ELT para ingesta, transformación, validación y actualización de datos estructurados y no estructurados. Desarrollo con Cypher: Crear y optimizar consultas complejas para recuperación de información, navegación de relaciones y procesamiento de datos en grafos. Implementación de Knowledge Graphs: Transformar taxonomías, ontologías y modelos conceptuales definidos por Data Science en estructuras productivas dentro de Neo4j. Integración con IA y RAG: Participar en la integración de Neo4j con embeddings, búsqueda vectorial y arquitecturas de recuperación semántica. Optimización de performance: Mejorar consultas, estrategias de indexación, consistencia de datos y escalabilidad de la base de grafos. Integración con Backend: Desarrollar integraciones mediante Python o Node.js para conectar los datos del grafo con aplicaciones, APIs y servicios internos. Calidad de datos: Implementar validaciones, controles automatizados y buenas prácticas para garantizar la integridad y confiabilidad de la información. Trabajo interdisciplinario: Colaborar con especialistas en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial y desarrollo de software para evolucionar la arquitectura de datos. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones similares. Neo4j: Experiencia práctica diseñando, implementando y manteniendo soluciones basadas en bases de datos de grafos. Cypher: Buen dominio del lenguaje para desarrollar consultas complejas, recorrer relaciones y optimizar operaciones sobre grafos. Modelado de datos: Conocimiento de modelos Property Graph, nodos, relaciones, labels, propiedades y buenas prácticas de diseño. ETL/ELT: Experiencia desarrollando pipelines de ingesta, transformación e integración de datos. Programación: Manejo de Python o Node.js para procesamiento de datos, automatización o integración con servicios. Optimización: Conocimiento de índices, constraints, optimización de consultas y performance de bases de datos. Arquitectura de datos: Capacidad para transformar requerimientos funcionales y técnicos en modelos de datos escalables y mantenibles. Fundamentos de IA: Familiaridad con embeddings, búsqueda semántica, bases vectoriales o conceptos de RAG. Autonomía y colaboración: Capacidad analítica, resolución de problemas, documentación técnica y buena comunicación con equipos interdisciplinarios. Será un plus Experiencia con Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG o arquitecturas de recuperación híbrida. Conocimiento de Neo4j APOC, Graph Data Science (GDS) o Neo4j Vector Index. Familiaridad con tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL. Experiencia integrando Neo4j con LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de IA. Experiencia con Neo4j AuraDB, despliegues cloud o entornos contenerizados. Conocimiento de NLP, extracción de entidades, procesamiento documental o enriquecimiento semántico. Familiaridad con Kafka, RabbitMQ o herramientas de procesamiento distribuido. Experiencia implementando pruebas automatizadas sobre grafos, validaciones de calidad de datos o herramientas de observabilidad. Experiencia previa en proyectos de LegalTech, RegTech, compliance o plataformas de gestión de conocimiento. ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Darwoft? Contrato full-time en relación de dependencia con pago en ARS. Trabajo 100% remoto. Salario competitivo. Licencias legales y vacaciones. Días personales adicionales al año. Acceso a plataformas de aprendizaje. Tarjeta de beneficios y descuentos. Welcome kit. Programas de reintegros. Clases de inglés. Programa de referidos. Regalo de cumpleaños. Healthy Break. Celebraciones al estilo Darwoft: aniversarios, fiestas de fin de año, cumpleaños y actividades de integración. Conocé esta y otras oportunidades en: Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph This is a remote position based in Germany. The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph, you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales. What You’ll Be Doing: Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact When you apply, please: Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective. Compensation & Rewards: In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 88,240 - EUR 105,888. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Signicatis a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About the Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory: a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes, with Go as our primary programming language. You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with event-driven architectures, workflow engines, distributed schedulers, or systems supporting long-running processes. You've experimented with AI coding agents, autonomous development workflows, or multi-agent systems. You have experience designing secure integrations with external services, including OAuth and delegated authorization. You've explored graph-based architectures, RDF, SPARQL, or event-driven systems, and are excited about using these concepts to model complex relationships, agent workflows, and dynamic, reactive applications. This is a wish list, not a checklist. You don't need to have worked with every technology or built AI agents before. If you're a strong engineer who loves solving complex problems and is excited about shaping the future of AI-driven software development, we'd love to hear from you. What we offer: Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences Remote work style -while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork Work-life balance - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss Salary: €70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Are you passionate about building robust data architectures that power next-generation, AI-driven business intelligence? Do you thrive in the intersection of data engineering and analytics, wearing both hats to design scalable backends and deliver actionable insights? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - Business Intelligence & Data Architecture to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows. This is a great opportunity for a highly technical analyst who is hands-on with Python, Databricks, and SQL, and is excited about creating the infrastructure that enables AI for BI. If you’re energized by the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data pipelines and advanced analytical outputs, we’d love to hear from you. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. In this role, you will: Act as the bridge between Data Engineering and Marketing Analytics, designing, building, and maintaining robust ETL pipelines and "Gold Layer" tables in Databricks. Develop and document semantic layers, data dictionaries, and markdown files designed specifically to train and enable AI agents for scalable, self-serve BI. Develop dashboards and analyses to surface business-critical KPIs and assess sales and marketing performance. Perform ad-hoc reporting and deep dives to uncover key insights across programs and initiatives to inform strategy and decision making. Partner with marketing stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models and analytics-ready datasets. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum requirements for the role: Bachelor's in Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Economics or other related analytical fields. 5+ years of relevant analytics, business intelligence, artificial intelligence or data engineering work experience. Expert in SQL, python, DBT and visualization platforms (Tableau preferred). Hands-on experience working with Databricks (or similar lakehouse architectures) to transform and model large datasets. Experience building data backends, semantic layers, and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis. Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows. Experience supporting Sales, Product or Marketing teams. An ideal candidate also has: Experience building interactive applications using Streamlit or Claude workflows. Experience building web applications Experience working in web analytics Sales and marketing experience including familiarity with MarTech tools. Navigate large, multifaceted datasets to answer hard questions — drawing on the right analytical or statistical approach for each problem. Data Science, machine learning or predictive analytics experience. Actively builds AI fluency relevant to BI and analytics work, including prompt engineering for data tasks, exploring AI-assisted features in tools, and staying current on how AI is reshaping the analytics landscape. Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $119,000—$180,000 USD Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. description: The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team. Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation. In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings. A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance What you will bring to the role Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc. Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career Experience using an exterprise level accounting system What we offer you Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce. In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process. Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004! Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Parental Leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’ Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #LI-remote

description: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. Job Overview COMPANY TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. Our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enables the distribution of power, signal, and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers, medical technology, and more. With more than 85,000 employees, including 9,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 130 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat and Instagram. BU / FUNCTION DESCRIPTION Key markets of Digital Data Networks are Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud, Enterprise/Telecommunications, Tier 3/Business Retail Equipment (BRE), and Internet of Things (IoT). In these markets, we are driving growth and innovation with an industry-leading product portfolio and global manufacturing capabilities. TE /448GB/shas specialized in socket products since 1970 and has developed a large size socket (>10K pin count), small pitch socket (<0.4mm pitch) for high-speed applications (224/448Gbps) ROLE OBJECTIVE As Principal R&D Product Development Engineer of the DDN socket team, you will focus on creating relationships with customer innovators and influencers, defining and driving technical activities, coordinating and facilitating technical engineering-related communications for internal/external customers, creating the product standard for a key technology, and contributing to the technical roadmap of the socket products. Job Requirements 1. Concept Development & Design • Develop innovative design concepts and conduct feasibility studies to assess technical and commercial viability. • Collaborate with global Product Design Engineering (PDE) teams to accurately convert VOC and PRD into detailed design inputs for precise socket development. • Create simplified 3D models and perform signal integrity (SI) simulations using advanced tools such as Ansys HFSS to validate electrical signal performance. • Build and test prototype samples, execute design validation plans, and complete product qualification to finalize specifications. 2. Strategic & Leadership Responsibilities • Lead end-to-end product development of high-speed, fine-pitch, large-size sockets—from market definition, concept creation to design, review, and production release. • Foster strong alignment between business and customer engineering teams to deepen market understanding and drive customer-centric innovation. • Responsible for mentoring and training engineering teams in advanced mechanical design principles and signal integrity simulation methodologies, including hands-on guidance in using industry-standard tools such as Creo and Ansys HFSS, to ensure design robustness, performance optimization, and alignment with high-speed interconnect requirements. 3. Customer & Market Engagement • Collaborate closely with customers and internal stakeholders (Sales, System Architects, FAEs, and PMs) to capture clear Voice of Customer (VOC) and translate it into conceptual designs and preliminary product specifications. • Engage in early-stage pathfinding with customers to co-develop cutting-edge interconnect solutions that meet future technological needs. • Prepare and present engineering evaluations and proposals to customers, aligning solutions with application requirements and performance targets 4. Manufacturing Support & Quality Assurance • Provide technical support to manufacturing and quality teams to ensure efficient ramp-up, process optimization, and safe product launches. • Support cross-functional teams—including customers, Sales, PMs, and manufacturing sites—through DFMEA, testing, troubleshooting, and engineering analysis. What your background should look like • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering; Master’s degree preferred. • Minimum of 5 years of work experience in mechanical design for high-speed interconnect products, with high-speed signal integrity knowledge preferred. • Direct customer design and support experience, including the ability to work with Field Application Engineers to troubleshoot customer problems and improve existing designs. • Design experience with high-speed servers, switches, and memory is a plus. • Understanding semiconductor IC packaging and fundamental test/burn-in methodology. • Expert-level knowledge of interconnect design or experience with high-speed connectors with PCIE Gen 6/7 compliance. • High level of competency in mechanical design tools such as Creo/SolidWorks. • Good level of competency in signal integrity analysis tools (Ansys HFSS, Keysight ADS). • Strong analytical capabilities to interpret simulation and lab data, identify issues, and provide solutions. • Six Sigma methodologies or other strong data analytics background is a plus. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. • Ability to work in a global environment, fluent in English (verbal/written), and able to collaborate across geographies. • Highly motivated, quick learner, and able to work independently. Competencies SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)
